description: GDPR + CPRA compliance overlay — consent capture, right-to-export / right-to-delete endpoints, data inventory manifest, cookie banner. Composes onto fullstack-ts / nextjs-ts / ecommerce-headless.

buildHints.whenToUse: Shipping to EU / CA / other jurisdictions with data-subject rights obligations. Bolt onto an existing fullstack/api backend.
firstSteps: Run `src/data-inventory.ts` to generate a first-draft Record of Processing Activities (RoPA). Customize per your product's schema.
Wire `/api/export-my-data` using `src/data-subject-rights.ts` — must respond within 30 days per Art. 12(3).
Wire `/api/delete-my-data` — must honor erasure within 30 days unless one of the Art. 17(3) exceptions applies.
Drop `CookieBanner.tsx` at the root layout — consent MUST be gathered BEFORE setting any non-essential cookies.
Fill out `docs/DPIA-template.md` if you process high-risk categories (Art. 35).
gotchas: 'Consent' as a legal basis has SIX requirements per Art. 4(11) — freely given, specific, informed, unambiguous, affirmative, withdrawable. Pre-ticked boxes are invalid.
Legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)) is often a better basis than consent for operational processing — but requires a documented LIA (Legitimate Interest Assessment).
Right-to-delete is NOT absolute. Exceptions: legal obligation, public interest, establishment of legal claims (Art. 17(3)). Document which exception applies when refusing.
Data breaches must be reported to the supervisory authority within 72 HOURS per Art. 33. Have the notification draft template pre-written.
CPRA (California) has parallel but not identical rules — the 'shine the light' + 'opt-out of sale' surfaces differ. This pack covers the shared 80%; add CPRA-specific flows as needed.
